Alex K: Postmortem follow-up: assign owners for guardrails - auto-rollback, flag scoping, recurrence detection.
Maria P: I’ll own auto-rollback. Draft multi-signal policy by Thu EOD.
Jon S: I’ll own blast-radius caps + token-bucket enforcement. Proposal ready Tue.
Irene C: I’ll prototype recurrence detection (flag+model clustering) and auto-epic flow; target end of sprint.
Taylor R: I’ll produce a 1-page oncall rollback checklist (validate signals -> rollback -> verify) by Mon.
Alex K: PM postmortem for context: https://redwood.company/postmortems/2026-03-22-service-degradation (see telemetry gaps).
Maria P: Quick rollback sketch pasted here:
```yaml
require_signals: 2
window: 10m
cooldown: 15m
notify: [eng-oncall, product-owner]
```
Jon S: Add staged rollout percents 1% -> 10% -> 100% and bucket_max_users: 5000 to limit blast radius. Also propose a global quarantine switch with 30s TTL (infra review required).
Alex K: Action items to track on the follow-ups board: Maria (auto-rollback, Thu EOD), Maria+Jon (canary + synthetic probes, next Tue), Jon (flag caps + quarantine spec, next Tue/Wed), Irene (recurrence + auto-epic, sprint end), Taylor (oncall checklist, Mon).
Alex K: @ops-bot remind: "Rollout guardrails sync" in 7 days. Prioritize safety over velocity for the next month.
